comment.default: # gpgv-static invocation for secure chroot signature verification
comment.description: A one-line comment above the command, describing its purpose.

bin_path.description: Absolute path to the gpgv-static binary. Usually /usr/bin/gpgv-static.

homedir.description: GnuPG home directory containing trustdb, keyrings, and config. Must be readable and contain trusted keys.

trusted_keys.description: List of keyring paths (e.g., /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg). Passed to --keyring. Empty list omits --keyring.

options.description: Additional gpgv-static options (e.g., ['--status-fd', '2']). Each element is a single CLI argument.

signed_files.description: List of signed files (e.g., [' Release', ' Release.gpg']). Required arguments for gpgv-static.
